title: 05 · moon · The Moon in His Hair
lines: The moon was once cursed to vanish forever.
Look at Shiva's hair, and you will see how that ended.
Chandra, the moon, married twenty-seven sisters.
But he loved only one. Rohini.
And the other twenty-six went home in tears.
You will fade, he said. Night by night. Until nothing is left.
"You will fade," he said. "Night by night. Until nothing is left."
And the moon began to die.
The tides stopped. The herbs withered. The nights went black.
With the last of his light,
A curse spoken cannot be unspoken.
Shiva lifted the last sliver of the moon,
and set it in his own hair.
So the moon still fades. Fifteen nights.
And then, from Shiva's head, it grows back. Fifteen nights.
You will have dark nights. You are not ending. That is sadhana.
